description: NaLiZnS₂ crystallizes in the trigonal P3m1 space group. Na is bonded to six S atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiS₄ tetrahedra, corners with six equivalent ZnS₄ tetrahedra, edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent LiS₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent ZnS₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.84 Å) and three longer (3.04 Å) Na-S bond lengths. Li is bonded to four S atoms to form distorted LiS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent LiS₄ tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent ZnS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-49°. There are three shorter (2.37 Å) and one longer (2.57 Å) Li-S bond length. Zn is bonded to four S atoms to form distorted ZnS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent ZnS₄ tetrahedra, edges with three equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent LiS₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-54°. There is one shorter (2.32 Å) and three longer (2.45 Å) Zn-S bond lengths. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Li, and three equivalent Zn atoms. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, three equivalent Li, and one Zn atom.
